principles: Gmail START must be provider-acknowledged before substantive work.
The same active assistant turn owns the normal tranche from START through substantive work and Gmail END.
Target 23 minutes of useful work, then reserve approximately 2 minutes for closeout.
Do not end the normal tranche merely because a visible reasoning/tool phase completed early.
Only a true human gate or tool/safety failure may justify an early close.
Scheduled automations are not the normal close path; they are emergency recovery only after a platform interruption.
Gmail END success requires provider message id plus SENT readback and durable CLOSED receipt.
Only after END acknowledgement may ChatGPT show the short Gmail pointer.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.

measurement_truth.chatgpt_thinking_indicator: NOT_AUTHORITATIVE; MAY_BE MUCH SHORTER_THAN TOTAL_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION; NEVER_USED_AS_WORK_PROOF
